card.name: Cmax and concentration in interaction text
card.fires_on: The word piece "max" in Cmax, or the word "concentration" after "minimal", in drug interaction passages about exposure changes.

modes.label: Cmax
modes.description: The "max" part of Cmax when comparing drug levels in interaction text.
modes.example: The mean C<< max>> and AUC of propranolol

modes.label: minimal concentration changes
modes.description: The word "concentration" after "minimal" in warnings about substrates of enzymes or transporters.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of XALKORI with CYP3A substrates where minimal<< concentration>> changes may lead to serious adverse reactions.

card.plain: It marks the point in drug interaction text where a peak level or a small concentration change is being described.
